dialogues.speaker: Dandy
dialogues.text: Hello traveler!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Start time trial challenge

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Who are you?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Dandy
dialogues.text: I am Dandy. I'm an adventurer specializing in mountaineering and other highly dangerous activities.

dialogues.speaker: Dandy
dialogues.text: The underground world is not for me, because combat is not my forte. It's also not easy to climb there.

dialogues.speaker: Dandy
dialogues.text: You want to put your top speed to the test? I totally understand, after all our goal is the stars and the abyss, right? Ad astra abyssosque!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let the challenge begin!

dialogues.speaker: Dandy
dialogues.text: This time, try to reach the destination within 40s.

dialogues.speaker: Dandy
dialogues.text: Keep going! You don't want to lose to your former self!

dialogues.speaker: Dandy
dialogues.text: This time, try to reach the destination within 55s.

dialogues.speaker: Dandy
dialogues.text: This time, try to reach the destination within 45s.

dialogues.speaker: Dandy
dialogues.text: Your prior achievements are impressive... But a great adventurer constantly seeks to improve.

dialogues.speaker: Dandy
dialogues.text: Let's see... This time, try to reach the destination within 45s.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Remind me what my personal best is?

dialogues.speaker: Dandy
dialogues.text: I remember your personal best is:

dialogues.speaker: Dandy
dialogues.text: {ChallengeIndex10}

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Never mind...

dialogues.speaker: Dandy
dialogues.text: What's wrong, not feeling it today? Well, there's always next time.

dialogues.speaker: Dandy
dialogues.text: Goodbye! May you always be blessed with the courage to face your challenges head on!

dialogues.speaker: Dandy
dialogues.text: The challenge has started.
